A particle moves along the \(x\)-axis with velocity given by \(v(t)=\frac{10 \sin \left(0.4 t^{2}\right)}{t^{2}-t+3}\) for time \(0 \leq t \leq 3.5\).
The particle is at position \(x=-5\) at time \(t=0\).
(a) Find the acceleration of the particle at time \(t=3\).
(b) Find the position of the particle at time \(t=3\).
(c) Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{3.5} v(t) d t\), and evaluate \(\int_{0}^{3.5}|v(t)| d t\). Interpret the meaning of each integral in the context of
the problem.
(d) A second particle moves along the \(x\)-axis with position given by \(x_{2}(t)=t^{2}-t\) for \(0 \leq t \leq 3.5\). At what
time \(t\) are the two particles moving with the same velocity?

\section*{Question 2}
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] \(v^{\prime}(3)=-2.118\)
The acceleration of the particle at time \(t=3\) is -2.118.
\item[(b)] \(x(3)=x(0)+\int_{0}^{3} v(t) d t=-5+\int_{0}^{3} v(t) d t=-1.760213\)
The position of the particle at time \(t=3\) is -1.760.
\item[(c)] \(\int_{0}^{3.5} v(t) d t=2.844\) (or 2.843)
\(\int_{0}^{3.5}|v(t)| d t=3.737\)
The integral \(\int_{0}^{3.5} v(t) d t\) is the displacement of the particle over the time interval \(0 \leq t \leq 3.5\).
The integral \(\int_{0}^{3.5}|v(t)| d t\) is the total distance traveled by the particle over the time interval \(0 \leq t \leq 3.5\).
\item[(d)] \(v(t)=x_{2}{ }^{\prime}(t)\)
\(v(t)=2 t-1 \Rightarrow t=1.57054\)
The two particles are moving with the same velocity at time \(t=1.571\) (or 1.570).
\end{itemize}
